phase: PHASE B.1 — MOTION CONTRACT RECONCILIATION & EVIDENCE CLOSURE

FX05.issue: Status/prose claimed 'Landing narrative only', while Effect Contract & Route Matrix allowed '/' and '/cases'.
FX05.resolution: LIMITED_TO_LANDING_AND_OPTIONAL_CASES_DESKTOP. Landing: allowed for one narrative section. Cases: allowed only for an optional desktop archival timeline if Phase C usability verifies it. Mobile: strictly unpinned standard vertical document flow (zero horizontal pinning). Native scroll strictly preserved (zero wheel interception).

FX07.issue: Effect contract listed allowedRoutes=['/'], but Route Matrix listed FX07 in forbiddenEffects for '/'.
FX07.resolution: LANDING_HERO_ONLY_MAX_3_NODES_DESKTOP. Landing hero background only, bounded to max 3 particles, desktop only, offscreen pause active. Strictly disabled on mobile and reduced motion. Forbidden on /trust and all other interior routes.

FX04.issue: 12px blur was ambiguously referenced as normal card blur rather than an absolute hero ceiling.
FX04.resolution: Standard Knowledge Glass card blur capped at 0–8px max (default 8px). 12px is a global absolute ceiling reserved for hero nav/modal only. Stacked/nested backdrop blur is strictly forbidden. Mobile blur is 0–4px max or flat background opacity.

FX12_NAMING.issue: Titled 'Interactive 3D Knowledge Orrery', which risked implying a WebGL/Three.js 3D engine.
FX12_NAMING.resolution: Renamed to 'Interactive Knowledge Atlas Orrery (2.5D)'. Implementation is strictly declarative SVG vectors and CSS orbital drift. WebGL, Three.js, and Canvas physics engines are strictly forbidden.

accessibilityCoverage.wcagWholeSiteClaim: NOT_CLAIMED (Reserved for Phase D full production validation)
accessibilityCoverage.keyboardFocus: VERIFIED (Tab navigation, :focus-visible ring, Escape key modal dismiss)
accessibilityCoverage.reducedMotion: VERIFIED (Instant static render, 0px translate, opacity-only transitions)

nonClaimsStatement: 1. No whole-site WCAG 2.2 AA or AAA compliance is claimed from harness testing alone.
2. No zero-cost GPU hardware-acceleration claim is made for box-shadow or backdrop-filter (classified as COMPOSITOR_FRIENDLY_WHERE_SUPPORTED).
3. No automated AI certainty is implied by FX10/FX11; human verification boundaries are preserved.
4. Concept artwork embedded UI is treated strictly as inert background illustration.

FX02_DEPTH_PARALLAX.rationale: Desktop hero background depth layer only; disabled on touch/mobile and all interior routes to eliminate motion sickness and preserve reading comfort.

FX05_EDITORIAL_SCROLL_CHOREOGRAPHY.rationale: Landing single narrative section and optional archival timeline; strictly unpinned vertical stack on mobile. Native scroll preserved (zero wheel hijacking).

FX07_AMBIENT_FIELD.rationale: Landing hero background only, bounded to max 3 drifting SVG particles, desktop only, offscreen pause active. Strictly disabled on mobile, reduced motion, and all interior routes.
